/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('out/notes.md')
s = p.read_text()
parts = re.split(r'"'^=== note: (.+) ==='"\\n', s, flags=re.M)
expected = ['B/problem/c_1/0', 'B/problem/c_2/0', 'B/problem/c_3/0', 'B/problem/c_4/0', 'B/visit/e_7', 'B/visit/e_9', 'B/med/m_5/1', 'B/visit/e_11', 'B/visit/e_13', 'B/visit/e_15', 'B/visit/e_17', 'B/med/m_5/2', 'B/visit/e_19', 'B/visit/e_21', 'B/visit/e_23']
assert parts[0] == ''
assert parts[1::2] == expected
assert not re.search(r'\\b(ibuprofen|Advil|NSAID)\\b', s, re.I)
for key, body in zip(parts[1::2], parts[2::2]):
    lines = body.strip().splitlines()
    visit = '/visit/' in key
    assert (3 <= len(lines) <= 7) if visit else (1 <= len(lines) <= 2)
    tags = re.findall(r'<ref id=\"(["'^"]+)">(.*?)</ref>'"', body, re.S)
    expected_id = None if visit else ('prob_1' if '/problem/' in key else 'med_1')
    assert [t[0] for t in tags] == ([] if visit else [expected_id])
    assert all('\\n\\n' not in t[1] for t in tags)
    assert '<' not in re.sub(r'<ref id=\"["'^"]+">.*?</ref>'"', '', body, flags=re.S)
notes = dict(zip(parts[1::2], parts[2::2]))
for key, dose in [('B/visit/e_11', 20), ('B/visit/e_19', 40)]:
    assert f'lisinopril changed to {dose} mg daily today' in notes[key]
    assert 'BP above goal' in notes[key]
vitals = {'e_7':'BP 134/77, pulse 63, wt 183 lb', 'e_9':'BP 142/87, pulse 69, wt 184 lb', 'e_11':'BP 145/88, repeat 138/87, pulse 79, wt 184 lb', 'e_13':'BP 131/73, pulse 65, wt 189 lb', 'e_15':'BP 139/85, pulse 75, wt 184 lb', 'e_17':'BP 140/86, repeat 138/82, pulse 64, wt 185 lb', 'e_19':'BP 144/92, repeat 141/89, pulse 73, wt 186 lb', 'e_21':'BP 130/80, pulse 79, wt 186 lb', 'e_23':'BP 137/81, pulse 62, wt 186 lb'}
for key, value in vitals.items():
    assert value in notes['B/visit/' + key]
assert sorted(f.name for f in p.parent.iterdir()) == ['notes.md']
print('Validated all 15 notes: headers, lengths, reference tags, required dose changes, vitals, and forbidden terms.')
PY"
